name: @the-hcma/blumkin-pi-skill
description: Pi package exposing the blumkin Agent Skill (personal Microsoft 365 via the blumkin CLI: calendar, mail, Teams chat, free/busy). Requires the separately installed `blumkin` binary on PATH.

scripts.prepack: rm -rf skills && mkdir -p skills && cp -R ../../.agents/skills/blumkin skills/blumkin
